text: BC, what the hell happened? Did I shake my way into Hell?
Another idiot. Came here to die? Ha ha ha.
Enter the dungeon at your own risk.
You are not seriously asking me to walk into your mouth.
Come on, idiot. I am your guide now.
You are really arguing with the only creature who knows the exit. Genius.
BC, ye kya hogaya? Hila-hila ke nark pahunch gaya kya main?
Ek aur chutiya... marne aaya hai? Ha ha ha.
Dungeon mein enter kar. Risk tera hai.
Tu serious hai? Main tere muh ke andar jaaun?
Aa chutiye. Ab main tera guide hoon.
Exit jaanta bhi nahi, attitude full hai. Genius.
